summary: RC4.3 re-verification after trigger loosening at /app/backend/routers/ops.py L1231-1232. 7/8 pass (all 5 request-listed flows for -Command/pwsh + both regressions now green), BUT Flow-1 (reviewer mixed-case comma-token example) REGRESSED from PASS to FAIL. Root cause: new trigger's second condition `\s-[A-Za-z]` requires WHITESPACE before the dash. Flow-1's input `PoWeRsHeLl.eXe,-NoPrOfIlE,-ExEcUtIoNpOlIcY,ByPaSs,-CoMmAnD,"..."` uses commas as separators — no whitespace precedes any dash — so powershell-normalize never fires and the router falls through to crypto-detect (recipe=['crypto-detect']). Net iteration_23 vs 24: Flow-2/3 fixed (as intended), Flow-1 broken (unintended regression). Flow-5 (pwsh) added and PASSES.

critical.issue: Trigger regression: Flow-1 (comma-separated PS with dash-prefixed params) no longer invokes powershell-normalize. Trigger at /app/backend/routers/ops.py L1232 uses `\s-[A-Za-z]` which does not match `,-NoPrOfIlE`. Observed recipe=['crypto-detect'] instead of ['powershell-normalize'].

action_items: In /app/backend/routers/ops.py L1232, change the second regex from `\s-[A-Za-z]` to `[\s,]-[A-Za-z]` (or `(?:^|[^A-Za-z0-9])-[A-Za-z]`) so comma-separated PS token lists still trigger the normalizer. This restores Flow-1 without regressing Flows 2/3/5 (they all have space before dash).
After fix, re-run: pytest backend/tests/test_rc43_smart_normalizer.py -v — expected 8/8 green.
critical_code_review_comments: The trigger predicate is a compound of two regex searches inline in the router — extract into a small helper `_looks_like_ps_commandline(src)` in ps_normalizer.py with unit coverage over: space-sep, comma-sep, tab-sep, mixed. This prevents future single-character regex regressions from silently breaking one shape.
The prior iteration_23 review comment (extract chain_injectors.py) still stands — ops.py is 1439 lines with 3 near-duplicate injector blocks.

Login can be slow (60-90s cold) — session-scoped token fixture with 3x retries at 90s each already in test file.
rca of the issue: Root cause: /app/backend/routers/ops.py L1231-1232 new trigger `_re.search(r"\\b(?:powershell(?:\\.exe)?|pwsh(?:\\.exe)?)\\b", src, _re.IGNORECASE) and _re.search(r"\\s-[A-Za-z]", src)`. Second condition requires whitespace before dash. Flow-1 input `PoWeRsHeLl.eXe,-NoPrOfIlE,-ExEcUtIoNpOlIcY,ByPaSs,-CoMmAnD,...` has commas, not spaces, so second regex fails → powershell-normalize skipped → falls through to crypto-detect. Repro: `curl -sX POST $URL/api/decode/smart -H 'Authorization: Bearer $T' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-raw '{"input":"PoWeRsHeLl.eXe,-NoPrOfIlE,-CoMmAnD,\"Write-Host x\""}'` → recipe=[{op: crypto-detect}]. Mitigation: broaden second regex to `[\s,]-[A-Za-z]` or drop it (matching on powershell/pwsh keyword alone is enough given the normalizer safely no-ops on non-PS input).
